name: Adam
role: TFAH literary character (Milton's Paradise Lost) -- the first man. DISTINCT from the historical/scriptural Gospel-book Adam entity (same universe, different book context, e.g. Luke's genealogy).
description: TFAH literary character, distinct from the Gospel-book Adam (referenced in Luke's genealogy). Category A (the facts) + D (nearly everything else) -- Genesis 1:26-31/2:7-25 gives only the bare facts; virtually all of Milton's Adam (courtship, conversations with Raphael, grief and reconciliation after the Fall) is Miltonic invention. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §VI.
narrative_function: Eats the fruit out of solidarity with Eve; receives Michael's vision of future history (Books XI-XII).
